name: Emergency fund
summary: Build an emergency fund with a set-aside schedule tied to payday and milestone dates along the way.
duration: Set by your target, usually 3 to 12 months

onboarding.prompt: How do you want to set the target?
onboarding.reaction: Either way, we'll turn it into dates.

onboarding.prompt: What's the target (amount, or number of months)?
onboarding.reaction: Got it. Big or small, it gets broken into bites.

onboarding.prompt: How much room do you have to save each month?
onboarding.reaction: Every bit counts. We'll show the finish date.

onboarding.prompt: When does money usually come in?
onboarding.reaction: Perfect. Transfers line up right after payday.

onboarding.prompt: Tap a time on payday to move money to savings.
onboarding.reaction: Reminder set. Two minutes, every payday.

phases.name: Set up
benchmarks: Savings spot chosen and first transfer made
actions: Pick a separate savings account or envelope
Set an automatic transfer if your bank offers one
Decide what counts as an emergency

phases.name: First milestone
benchmarks: First $500 or one week of expenses saved
actions: Monthly check: on track, ahead or behind

phases.name: Keep going
actions: Quarterly review of the target as life changes

plan_blueprint.calendar: A short transfer reminder on each payday, a monthly check-in, and milestone dates calculated from the target and monthly amount.

approach_variants.habit: Same transfer every payday, set to automatic where possible; streak of paydays saved.
approach_variants.willpower: Monthly savings challenge (for example a no-takeout week added to the fund).
approach_variants.time: Every transfer and review is a calendar block; monthly time-and-money review.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-picked small reward at each 25% milestone.
approach_variants.resource: First steps open the savings spot, list monthly expenses and find one cost to trim.

guardrails: This plan is general education, not financial advice. Check big decisions with a qualified professional.
Account numbers and log-ins are never asked for; you enter only the totals you choose.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A skipped payday is fine; the plan recalculates the finish date instead of asking for a double transfer. If savings are used for a real emergency, the plan celebrates that it worked and rebuilds from the new balance.
